item.title: Chillicothe R-II School District Revenue
item.description: January is a big month for the Chillicothe R-II School District finances. Superintendent Dr. Dan Wiebers noted the property tax payments supply a majority of the funds. Collected just over 9 million in January, and 18 million year to date. Dr. Wiebers says this reflects about 70% of the expected revenues for the district. […]

item.title: Livingston County 911 Board Meets Thursday
item.description: The Livingston County Central Dispatch Services Board will meet Thursday at 6:00 pm at the Home of Sliced Bread Building. The agenda includes a building update and contracts. The board may go into closed executive session.
